executive_summary_zh: 今天候选内容整体信号较弱，只有一条与开发者工具链安全和自动化凭证管理直接相关的高质量原始更新。
GitHub CLI 开始支持可过期且自动刷新的 OAuth 凭证，这对平台工程、开发者工作站安全、以及 agent/CLI 在本地与 CI 中的认证策略有实际影响。
其核心价值不在 AI 编码能力本身，而在于为更安全的开发代理与命令行自动化提供更短生命周期的令牌模型。
executive_summary_en: The candidate set is weak today, with only one original, high-signal update directly relevant to developer tooling security and automation.

GitHub CLI now supports expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth credentials, which matters for platform engineering, developer workstation security, and authentication patterns used by agents and CLIs locally and in CI.
The value is not an AI coding capability per se, but a safer token lifecycle model for developer automation and coding-agent-adjacent workflows.

items.title: GitHub CLI: Opt in to expiring, auto-refreshing OAuth tokens
items.summary_zh: GitHub 在 gh v2.103.0 中提供公开预览：用户可通过 --expiring 启用可过期访问令牌与轮换 refresh token，CLI 会在后台自动刷新认证状态。若配合 gh auth setup-git 与较新的 Git 版本使用，HTTPS git 凭证也可按生命周期正确刷新与失效，减少长期静态令牌暴露风险。
items.summary_en: GitHub introduced a public preview in gh v2.103.0 for expiring OAuth access tokens paired with rotating refresh tokens. With --expiring enabled, gh refreshes credentials automatically in the background. When combined with gh auth setup-git and newer Git versions, HTTPS git credentials can also be refreshed and expired correctly, reducing the exposure window of long-lived static tokens.
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对平台团队而言，这是一项低摩擦但高价值的认证改进：开发者和自动化脚本不必频繁重新登录，却能摆脱长期有效 PAT/CLI token 的风险。对于正在引入本地 coding agent、CLI 驱动自动化和 repo 操作机器人的组织，这种短生命周期凭证模式更接近未来默认安全基线。
items.why_it_matters_en: For platform teams, this is a low-friction, high-value authentication upgrade: developers and automation keep working without repeated re-login, while avoiding the risk profile of long-lived PATs or CLI tokens. For organizations adopting local coding agents, CLI-driven automation, and repo-manipulating bots, this short-lived credential model is closer to a future default security baseline.
key_takeaways_zh: gh 现在支持 access token 过期 + refresh token 轮换的模式，并自动在后台续期。
若要让 git over HTTPS 正确处理短期凭证，建议将 gh 配置为 git credential helper，并升级到 Git 2.46+。
key_takeaways_en: gh now supports expiring access tokens plus rotating refresh tokens, with automatic background renewal.
To make short-lived credentials work correctly for git over HTTPS, GitHub recommends using gh as the git credential helper and upgrading to Git 2.46+.

implications_zh: 如果你的团队仍依赖长期有效的 gh/PAT 凭证，可开始评估在开发者工作站上迁移到可过期 token 模式。
对使用本地 AI coding agent、repo 自动化脚本或开发容器的组织而言，应同步检查 git credential helper、Git 版本和 token 缓存行为。
后续值得关注的是该模型是否扩展到更广泛的 CLI、MCP 客户端与机器身份访问路径。
implications_en: If your team still relies on long-lived gh or PAT credentials, it is worth evaluating a workstation migration to expiring token flows.
Organizations using local AI coding agents, repo automation scripts, or dev containers should also review git credential helper settings, Git version, and token caching behavior.
A key follow-up question is whether this model expands to broader CLI, MCP client, and machine-identity access paths.
